meaning:
ἀπο-βαίνω
[in LXX for הָיָה, etc. ;]
to step off, disembark: Luk.5:2, Jhn.21:9; metaphorically, of events, to issue, turn out (Field, Notes, 74): Luk.21:13, Php.1:19 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
For I know that this will turn out to my salvation, through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
